messages:
taylor: Quick follow-up from the outage postmortem: we need owners for the remediation tests and a clear handoff timeline. Can folks claim tasks?

mina: I'll take the prompt/regression set. Plan: extract ~40 failing prompts, add expected labels, and add to nightly canary. ETA: Fri.

ben: I'll do the load reproduction. Will create a small Gatling scenario to replay the burst and parameterize kv_hit. Prototype by Tue.

mina: Also tagging examples with incident id and short rationale so future triage finds them.

ci-bot: Created tickets: RGR-900 (regression), LD-901 (load). Links: https://redwood.internal/issue/RGR-900, https://redwood.internal/issue/LD-901

taylor: Ownership policy: remediation owner for 60 days, then rotate to platform-maintainers. Adding a 60-day review card. I'll mark tickets as release blockers if not done by their due dates.

ben: For determinism I'll record seeds and a small trace for KV hit simulation.

mina: I'll add eval harness scoring + a short README for the promptset.

taylor: Estimated effort: RGR-900 ~2d, LD-901 ~4d. Thanks everyone, will sync in Monday standup and post summary to the postmortem thread.
